metadata.description: expert-bootstrap — a Claude Code skill that generates a project-tailored council of domain experts.

plugins.name: expert-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap a project-local council of generated domain experts. Two meta-agents (prompt-engineer + project-manager) read your project goal and design a tailored 3–4 expert roster on the fly, written to ./.claude/agents/ on Claude Code or ./skills/<name>/SKILL.md on portable hosts (Codex CLI, etc.). Triggers on: /expert-bootstrap, 组建专家组, set up the experts, build the expert council, convene the expert council, form the expert committee.
